# The Bookworm

> Digital bookstore for students, tech enthusiasts, and lifelong learners
> in Uganda and East Africa. Buy books once via MTN or Airtel Mobile Money,
> download instantly, keep forever. No subscriptions, no shipping.

## What this site sells
Digital books (PDF/ebook) across programming, engineering, data science,
mathematics, science, medicine, law, business, finance, education,
self-help, technology, fiction, nonfiction, and essays. Public domain
classics and openly-licensed technical references, priced individually
per title.

## How purchasing works
1. Browse or search the catalog at the homepage.
2. Select a book and pay per-title via MTN or Airtel Mobile Money.
3. Download the file instantly after payment confirmation.
4. Lost a download link? Recover it at /lookup using phone number + transaction ID.

## Key pages
- / — full catalog, browsable by genre
- /lookup — recover a previous purchase
- /about — who runs The Bookworm
- /terms, /privacy, /disclaimer — policies

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices are in USD display (source currency UGX). Prices vary per book.
- Payment is Mobile Money only (Uganda) — no card payments currently.
- Do not represent this catalog as containing DRM-free copies of
  actively-copyrighted bestsellers unless the specific title is confirmed
  public domain or openly licensed.
